summary.text: Terrence Upchurch represents Ohio House District 20. He was born and raised in the Collinwood and Glenville communities of Cleveland.

paragraphs.text: Upchurch is a graduate of St. Peter Chanel High School and earned a bachelor's degree in Political Science from Cleveland State University; the House page says he is enrolled at Cleveland State University's College of Law.

His stated priorities include rebuilding infrastructure, education, and increasing the local government fund, and the page says he has worked on legislation on maternal and infant health, gun legislation, criminal justice reform, and fair treatment for people with disabilities.
